- [x] I agree to license this contribution under the terms of [LICENSE.txt](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/blob/develop/LICENSE.txt).

- [ ] I added GitHub labels: one `cat-*`, one or more `area:*` / `op:*`, and one `orig-*` (see [label list](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/labels)). *(Fork contributor cannot apply labels. Please add `cat-doc` and `orig-nv-eng`. None of the current `area:*` / `op:*` labels match a documentation-only install change.)*

## Affected area

- Documentation or samples

## Summary

- Replace the eight SUSE network and local `zypper` install commands in `docs/installation/linux.mdx` with `sudo zypper --non-interactive install`.

## Why

NVBugs bug 6929079. The SUSE network and local install sections passed DNF's `--allowerasing` to Zypper. The [openSUSE Leap 15.6 Zypper manual](https://manpages.opensuse.org/Leap-15.6/zypper/zypper.8.en.html) does not define that option, so those commands cannot be followed as written. `--non-interactive` is the global option the manual recommends, and it must come before `install`. The old `-y` flag is a valid install alias for `--no-confirm`, but the manual recommends the global option instead. The `dnf` and `tdnf` commands still use `--allowerasing`. `--force-resolution` was not added because the manual advises against it for unattended installs, and a conflict-resolution workflow should be documented only after it is validated.

## Related issues

NVBugs bug 6929079

## API and compatibility impact

None

## Testing

- Docs-only change. Compared the eight commands with the openSUSE Leap 15.6 Zypper manual. No SUSE installation was executed.
- `pre-commit` was not run.

detail.title: Use Zypper's supported install syntax for SUSE

files.patch:
@@ -272,25 +272,25 @@ Only one CUDA toolkit version of cuDNN 9 can be installed at a time.
     To install for CUDA 12, run:
 
     ```
-    sudo zypper -y install --allowerasing cudnn9-cuda-12
+    sudo zypper --non-interactive install cudnn9-cuda-12
     ```
 
     To install for CUDA 13, run:
 
     ```
-    sudo zypper -y install --allowerasing cudnn9-cuda-13
+    sudo zypper --non-interactive install cudnn9-cuda-13
     ```
 
     To install cuDNN JIT for CUDA 12, run:
 
     ```
-    sudo zypper -y install --allowerasing cudnn9-jit-cuda-12
+    sudo zypper --non-interactive install cudnn9-jit-cuda-12
     ```
 
     To install cuDNN JIT for CUDA 13, run:
 
     ```
-    sudo zypper -y install --allowerasing cudnn9-jit-cuda-13
+    sudo zypper --non-interactive install cudnn9-jit-cuda-13
     ```
 
 <Note>
@@ -731,25 +731,25 @@ And `$architecture` is one of the following:
     To install for CUDA 12, run:
 
    ```
-   sudo zypper -y install --allowerasing cudnn9-cuda-12
+   sudo zypper --non-interactive install cudnn9-cuda-12
    ```
 
     To install for CUDA 13, run:
 
    ```
-   sudo zypper -y install --allowerasing cudnn9-cuda-13
+   sudo zypper --non-interactive install cudnn9-cuda-13
    ```
 
     To install cuDNN JIT for CUDA 12, run:
 
    ```
-   sudo zypper -y install --allowerasing cudnn9-jit-cuda-12
+   sudo zypper --non-interactive install cudnn9-jit-cuda-12
    ```
 
     To install cuDNN JIT for CUDA 13, run:
 
    ```
-   sudo zypper -y install --allowerasing cudnn9-jit-cuda-13
+   sudo zypper --non-interactive install cudnn9-jit-cuda-13
    ```
